items.title: 61426_Jacques Butler oral history interview
items.q: and he's hollering Jacques, Jacques -- he had one of them strange voices

ctx.x: She said, 'I can't get across the frontier, that war has been declared and I can't cross the frontier.' That was it. So I said, well, let them do what they got to do. I wouldn't care less, but the next day, there was a -- I heard

someone calling me.

The fellow was named Pops Foster. He was a comedian and he was an old fellow. He was a comedian and a dancer. and he's hollering Jacques, Jacques -- he had one of them strange voices that could carry but you could hear him.

So, I --
So, he's different from the Pops Foster that --
